questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All racks are books.

All racks are pens.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pens are books.

II. Some books are pens.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
Statements:

All racks are books.

All racks are pens.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca75058bbc998f7796a52e854f0cd04d49fb01db5ee70480fb95134f6dcb99b7.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All pens are books → False (It is possible but not definite)

II. Some books are pens → True (Because all racks are books and all racks are also pens so some books are also pens)

Hence, “**Only conclusion II follows**”.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

9 : 99 : : 15 : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**(1st number)² + (1st number × 2) = 2ⁿd number**

**Now follow the steps:**

9 : 99

**(1st number)² + (1st number × 2)**

= 9² + (9 × 2)

= 81 + 18

= 99** = 2ⁿd number**

**Similarly,**

15 : ?

**(1st number)² + (1st number × 2)**

= 15² + (15 × 2)

= 225 + 30

= 255** = 2ⁿd number**

Hence, **"255" **is correct answer.

questions.question: In an entrance test, Tiwari scored 25% marks and failed by 64 marks. If he had scored 40% marks, then he would have secured 32 marks more than the pass marks. Find the pass marks.
questions.solution:
**Let,**

**X is the passing mark**

**Y is the total marks.**

**Given:**

**1) **Tiwari scored 25% marks and failed by 64 marks.

X – 64 = 25%Y **-------- eq. (1)**

2) He had scored 40% marks, then he would have secured 32 marks more than the pass marks.

X + 32 = 40%Y **-------- eq. (2)**

**Subtract eq. (2) from eq. (1)**

=> (X + 32) – (X – 64) = 40%Y - 25%Y

=> 32 + 64 = 15%Y

=> 96 = 15%Y

=> Y = 96 ÷ (15/100)</p&

questions.question:
Which two digits and signs need to be interchanged so as to balance the given equation?

26 ÷ 6 − 54 + 24 × 8 = 174
questions.solution:
According to the BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

**Option 1 :** 8 and 6; × and ÷

Given:

**26 ÷ 6 − 54 + 24 × 8 = 174**

**After interchange the signs;**

**28 × 8 − 54 + 24 ÷ 6 = 174**

**By BODMAS rule**

**28 × 8 − 54 + 4 = 174**

**224 − 54 + 4 = 174**

**228 − 54 = 174**

**174 = 174**** (LHS = RHS)**

**Option 2 : **6 and 4; − and ×

Given:

26 ÷ 6 − 54 + 24 × 8 = 174

After interchange the signs;

24 ÷ 4 × 56 + 26 - 8 = 176

By BODMAS rule

6 × 56 + 26 - 8 = 176

336 + 26 - 8 = 176

362 - 8 = 176

354 ≠ 176** (LHS ≠ RHS)**

**Option 3 :** 4 and 2; + and ÷

Given:

26 ÷ 6 − 54 + 24 × 8 = 174

After interchange the signs;

46 + 6 − 52 ÷ 42 × 8 = 172

By BODMAS rule

46 + 6 – 1.24 × 8 = 172

46 + 6 – 9.92 = 172

52 – 9.92 = 172

42.08 ≠ 172** (LHS ≠ RHS)**

**Option 4 :** 5 and 8; × and +

Given:

26 ÷ 6 − 54 + 24 × 8 = 174

After interchange the signs;

26 ÷ 6 − 84 × 24 + 5 = 174

By BODMAS rule

4.34 − 84 × 24 + 5 = 174

4.34 − 2016 + 5 = 174

9.34 − 2016 = 174

-2006.66 ≠ 174** (LHS ≠ RHS)**

Hence, the answer is **“****8 and 6; × and ÷****”.**

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

25 ∶ 75 ∶ 150
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Step → 1st number**

**Step → 2ⁿd number = 1st number × (Difference of 1st number digits)**

**Step → 3rd number = 2ⁿd number × (Difference of 2ⁿd number digits)**

For 25 ∶ 75 ∶ 150

Step → 1st number = 25

Step → 2ⁿd number = 25 × (5 - 2) = 25 × 3 = 75

Step → 3rd number = 75 × (7 - 5) = 75 × 2 = 150

**Option 1 → **36 ∶ 108 ∶ 324

Step → 1st number = 36

Step → 2ⁿd number = 36 × (6 - 3) = 36 × 3 = 108

Step → 3rd number = 108 × (10 - 8) = 108 × 2 = 216 ≠ 324

**Option 2** → 18 ∶ 126 ∶ 253

Step → 1st number = 18

Step → 2ⁿd number = 18 × (8 - 1) = 18 × 7 = 126

Step → 3rd number = 126 × (12 - 6) = 126 × 6 = 756 ≠ 253

**Option 3 → 13 ∶ 26 ∶ 104**

**Step → 1st number = 13**

**Step → 2ⁿd number = 13 × (3 - 1) = 13 × 2 = 26**

**Step → 3rd number = 26 × (6 - 2) = 26 × 4 = 104**

**Option 4** → 29 ∶ 36 ∶ 72

Step → 1st number = 29

Step → 2ⁿd number = 29 × (9 - 2) = 29 × 7 = 203 ≠ 36

Step → 3rd number = 36 × (6 - 3) = 36 × 3 = 108 ≠ 72

Hence, the correct answer is **"****13 ****∶**** 26 ****∶**** 104****".**
